name: authenticated_shadow_comparison_runner_plan
purpose: Define the future local-only runner contract for real authenticated Study and Companion shadow comparisons without storing secrets.

required_environment.name: EDGE_AUTH_SHADOW_COMPARE_BASE_URL
required_environment.purpose: Local base URL such as http://127.0.0.1:7070

one_of_auth_environment.name: EDGE_AUTH_SHADOW_COMPARE_COOKIE
one_of_auth_environment.purpose: Ephemeral authenticated cookie header value for local test run

one_of_auth_environment.name: EDGE_AUTH_SHADOW_COMPARE_BEARER
one_of_auth_environment.purpose: Ephemeral bearer token for local test run

optional_environment.name: EDGE_AUTH_SHADOW_COMPARE_OUTPUT
optional_environment.purpose: Temporary output path for sanitized comparison artifact

optional_environment.name: EDGE_AUTH_SHADOW_COMPARE_LABEL
optional_environment.purpose: Safe test identity label such as normal_test_user

future_runner_required_behavior: fail closed if base URL is missing
fail closed if domain is missing or unsupported
fail closed if neither cookie nor bearer auth is provided
never print cookie or bearer values
never write cookie or bearer values to disk
never store raw authenticated route responses by default
summarize current route responses into response classes
call the local shadow helper only in-process
validate output artifact with Stage 7E validator before success
write artifacts only after redaction and validation
